raw_definitions: Definisi : n 1. a. ( in ancient Greece ) priest, priestess who made predictions, ahli ramal; b. shrine where such predictions were made, tempat keramat: the ~ at Delphi; tempat keramat di Delphi; c. prophesy, ramalan; 2. ( sometimes derog ) person capable of giving wise, authoritative advice or opinion, orang yg bijaksana. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
